newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westfield looks at A$2 bln of work.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westfield looks at A$2 bln of work.

text.p: Westfield Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it is looking at A$2.0 billion worth of retail development projects over the next five to seven years.

Chairman Frank Lowy told the annual meeting that the shopping centre management group's Australian growth plan involves 15 major projects with an individual value of A$50 million or more and a total value exceeding A$2.0 billion.

"We are moving forward with confidence as there is strong demand from retailers for the new space which we are creating. With a work load such as this we are well placed in Australia into the next century," Lowy said.
"The market for the supply of retail space (in Australia) is highly competitive," Lowy said.
Lowy said Westfield was able to achieve greater penetration of the immediate and surrounding trade areas at its centres through upgrading the centres.
"This makes space in our centres highly sought after by retailers, thereby underpinning the high occupancy rate in our centres," Lowy said.
Westfield shares last traded on Monday at A$20.34, a five cent rise on the day.
